topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 53 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 19 ERC20 tokens, 4 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on aave.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 19 common project-authored base contract(s) (versionedinitializable, scaledbalancetokenbase, mintableincentivizederc20). Dominant framework: aave.
